acceptedAnswer.text: In many areas, including parts of Las Vegas, a mother-in-law suite (ADU) can indeed be rented out, providing a valuable source of income. However, rental regulations can vary by specific zoning districts and local ordinances. It's crucial to understand any restrictions on short-term versus long-term rentals or specific occupancy limits that might apply to ADUs in your particular neighborhood. We can help you understand the general feasibility from a construction standpoint, but we recommend checking specific rental rules with local planning departments.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, mother-in-law suites can often be rented out for income, but local zoning and rental regulations in areas like Las Vegas vary and should be verified.
